'''Faramozan''' is the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Capital capital] of [[Ukhdari]], an [[Ayuma|Ayuman]] economy and the twelfth-largest national economy by nominal [[List of countries by GDP (nominal)|GDP]] in the world. The city had a population of 1,029,000 at the [[Ukhdari]] 1764 census; though comparatively small in population terms relative to [[Ukhdari]]'s economic standing, the city is the administrative and ceremonial capital of the country. Faramozan hosted both the opening match and the final of the [[1760 FLLA World Cup]] at the 92,000-seat Stadion Faramozan, where [[Verusa]] beat [[Raledria]] 2–1 in the final, and is the seat of the Ukhdari Arraby Association.
